title: Landscape paper — HCM AI platforms, mid-2026 (eleven claimants, three actual platforms)
summary: First flagship landscape paper in Eglin's library — a 6,000-word comparative read across the eleven vendors claiming HCM AI-platform status in mid-2026. Headline finding: only Workday (ASOR), SAP (Joule + Joule Studio), and Oracle (AI Agent Studio) clear the Tier-C bar of named agents + registry/governance surface + open-protocol extensibility. Cornerstone, Rippling, Eightfold, Paradox, Beamery, and Gloat ship sophisticated AI features at Tier B; iCIMS and SmartRecruiters are Tier-A copilots, not platforms. The comparative matrix applies a verified-vs-claimed audit uniformly to ten columns including LLM-provider disclosure, bias/eval methodology, MCP support, third-party extensibility, and graph/skills primitive. Honest Stratum positioning section: three claims survive the comparative read (cross-system MCP architecture, governance-as-artifact, cross-system relational primitive); three are contested (MCP-native phrase is now table-stakes after Greenhouse/Workday/SAP, people-graph noun is at editorial risk after Cornerstone's 2026-05-20 trademark notation, ASOR genuinely matches Stratum's architectural claim and surface area exceeds Stratum's). Vocabulary battles section maps six contested nouns (People Graph, Talent Graph, Skills Engine, Agent of Record/ASOR, Workforce Readiness, MCP-native) with claimant order and trademark posture. Tier-coded posture: ship people-graph technical-depth page within 14 days (Forge/Yield, T1); publish eval-set v2 with cross-vendor probes within 30 days (Kernel, T1); reframe positioning umbrella from 'MCP-native HCM' to 'the cross-system agent layer the suite vendors will not build' within 21 days (Compass/Helm, T2); battlecards for SAP, Oracle, Beamery within 30 days, Paradox and Gloat within 60 days. Surprises during research: Oracle's AI Agent Studio is materially more credible than the trade press credits; Beamery's Holistic AI third-party bias audit is the strongest AI-fairness posture in the cohort outside Stratum's own eval set; SAP is the most LLM-provider-transparent suite vendor by explicitly naming Anthropic and Nvidia. Distribution-surface sidebar names Microsoft 365 Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce, ServiceNow, Slack/Teams, and SAP Joule itself as the surfaces through which most HCM agents will be consumed — a dimension under-discussed in trade-press category coverage. Eglin index updated with a new sixth stream card (Landscape · flagship) and the Latest list backfilled with Cornerstone battlecard No. 022. Recommended Compact reading time: full read, end-to-end.
